metadata.title: Using Machine Learning Approaches to Explore Non-Cognitive Variables Influencing Reading Proficiency in English among Filipino Learners

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used a single plausible value for analysis, which does not meet the criteria for proper handling of plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Recorded evidence does not explicitly establish an unweighted analysis. Original extraction rationale: The study does not mention the application of sampling weights in its analysis of the PISA data.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study appears to use student-level models without accounting for school clustering, as it does not mention any multilevel modeling or cluster-robust standard errors.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions using internal validation methods such as cross-validation and train/test splits, which do not qualify as validation beyond the estimation sample.
